Adaptive binaural audio generation without loops

pillars.title: Native on both platforms
pillars.description: Swift and SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android. It takes longer, but the apps feel like they belong on your phone.

pillars.title: Your data stays yours
pillars.description: Whenever we can, things run on your device. We don’t sell data and we only collect what an app actually needs to work.

pillars.title: Sweat the details
pillars.description: Scrolling, haptics, typography, empty states — the small stuff is most of what makes an app pleasant, so we spend time on it.

pillars.title: Keep shipping
pillars.description: We update our apps regularly, translate them into the languages our users speak, and actually read the reviews.

policyDocument.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how Master Dev ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, protects, uses, and shares information when you use our mobile applications distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play Store (CH Play), as well as our official website.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect and Process
sections.content:
Our applications are designed with on-device processing at the core. We do not require you to create accounts for single-user offline utilities. When data is collected, it includes strictly essential information:

• Device & Diagnostic Data: Non-identifiable device models, operating system versions, and anonymized crash logs to ensure app stability.
• User Content: Any documents, images, habits, or notes created in our apps are stored locally on your device or in your personal cloud accounts (Apple iCloud or Google Drive) with zero server-side access by Master Dev.
• In-App Purchases: Transaction processing is handled exclusively by Apple StoreKit or Google Play In-App Billing. Master Dev never stores credit card or financial credentials.

sections.title: 2. Mobile Device Permissions
sections.content:
Our applications may request permission to access certain hardware features only when strictly required for explicit user features:

• Camera: Required for document scanning or photo editing. Frames are processed entirely in memory.
• Notifications: Optional alerts for focus timers, daily habit reminders, and critical app updates.
• Storage / Media: To allow you to import and export files on Android devices.

You can revoke these permissions at any time through your device's operating system settings.

sections.title: 3. Third-Party Service Providers
sections.content:
To deliver reliable mobile experiences, we partner with verified industry-standard SDKs:

• Apple StoreKit & Google Play Core: Digital purchase verification and licensing.
• Google Play Services: Core security and performance diagnostics.
• Anonymized Analytics: Aggregated crash telemetry (Firebase Crashlytics / Apple App Analytics) that contains no personally identifiable data.

sections.title: 4. GDPR & CCPA Compliance
sections.content:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), users possess the right to:

• Access any data held regarding their device.
• Request immediate deletion of any associated telemetry.
• Opt-out of non-essential analytics at any moment.

Since we do not maintain centralized user identity databases, your privacy remains mathematically safeguarded.

sections.title: 5. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our applications comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you believe an app has inadvertently collected data from a minor, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: 6. Contact Information & Data Protection Officer
sections.content:
If you have any questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our data privacy officer at:

Master Dev Legal & Privacy Team
Email: nganmaster13@gmail.com
Response time: Within 48 business hours.
